A small floating app for your Mac or PC that lets you talk out loud to your AI coding assistant — and hear it answer in a natural voice. What's a "coding agent"? An AI assistant developers run alongside their code — tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Gemini CLI. It can read files, write code, run tests, and answer questions. SKI gives it ears and a voice. How does SKI actually work? You speak; SKI turns it into text on your machine and hands it to your coding agent. The agent does the work — reads files, writes code, runs tests — then sends its reply back to SKI, which speaks it aloud in a natural voice and shows it in the pill or notch. A full spoken round-trip, over plain files in your own project. What is silent mode? Silent mode keeps SKI listening and replying, but the agent's answers appear only as text in the pill or notch — not spoken aloud (handy in a quiet room or on a call). It's the mirror of mute: mute silences your mic going in; silent silences the agent's voice coming out. Do I have to keep the mic on the whole time? No — mute it any time and SKI stops listening and releases the mic. On Mac you can also use the globe / fn key: tap to mute or unmute, or hold it as push-to-talk (Mac only; opt-in, needs one macOS permission). How is this different from other voice tools? Most are speech-to-text dictation — they put your words in a box and stop. SKI is a two-way voice loop for coding agents: it answers out loud, and it shows you what your agent is doing. Different job. Do I need an internet connection? No. Listening, understanding, and speaking all happen on your own machine. The only feature that touches the internet is sending your agent into a video meeting — and that's optional. Is my voice recorded or sent anywhere? No. Your voice becomes text on your own machine and is never uploaded. There's no cloud service listening in — there is nothing to upload to. How much does it cost? Free forever on Mac and Windows — register once, no credit card. Voice features and the meeting transcriber are all included. You only pay if you want your agent to join video calls through AgentCall — per minute, with free hours included. How does SKI record meetings? Two ways. Record locally — free, unlimited, on-device: SKI captures your mic and the meeting audio on separate tracks and transcribes them on your machine; nobody joins the call and nothing is uploaded (no per-speaker diarization in this mode).
